title: 3 Anime to Watch If You Miss Fairy Tail
content:
Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest finished airing in January 2025, and before that fans of the series hadn’t had anything before the main anime finished airing in 2019. Fairy Tail has always been on the lower rung of the shonen popularity ladder. The anime franchise resonates with a smaller, passionate fanbase, but never quite draws the mainstream attention of shows like One Piece or Naruto .

With Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest only being 25 episodes long , and with no announcements of further adaptations fans of the anime may be looking for other titles to watch. If you’re just looking for a shonen action series then there are plenty to choose from, but Fairy Tail strikes a unique blend of action and charm that is hard to replicate. The show has a fun, lovable cast that are more than the enemies they defeat and the battles they fight. That being said, some of these anime may hold enjoyment for fans of the series.

3) My Hero Academia

My Hero Academia is a series that certainly needs no introduction. The anime has become one of the most recognizable modern shonen. My Hero Academia and Fairy Tail share some key similarities. Firstly, Deku and All Might’s power is something that only works because of the combined wills of multiple people, which is very similar to how the Fairy Tail guild members win most of their fights (think “power of friendship”).

Secondly, UA High School in the world of My Hero Academia functions similarly to the Fairy Tail guild. It contains all of the main characters and is often the place from which the characters depart for battle or even the site of battle itself. Both anime give their characters time to shine so it will be easy to find one that you like. My Hero Academia will be a good choice if you liked the fighting and magical power aspects of Fairy Tail.

2) Soul Eater

For people who loved the quirky aspects of Fairy Tail like the characters and comedy, this will be a good watch. Soul Eater aired around the same time as the original Fairy Tail series, and all the charm that anime of that era had. The fights and abilities in the universe are outrageous much like in Fairy Tail . Characters can turn into weapons, and other characters use them to fight. The art style and character designs for both the weapons and people are fun and unique. The anime manages to be colorful and dark at the same time with its world design.

Unlike in a lot of anime, the characters also act their age. When there are ridiculous moments they react accordingly and behave in ways that fit their age and character. Each of the characters in Soul Eate r feel so drastically distinct, and different from each other too. This was during a time when a lot of the character tropes of modern shonen were still being established, and even now characters like the ones in Fairy Tail and Soul Eater feel like their own people.

1) Black Clover

Not only is there magic in this one but it has the found family aspect of Fairy Tail that fans of the series love. The big departure from Fairy Tail is how much of an underdog Asta is in the beginning of the series. There is a lot of focus on his growth and how he learns to adapt that fans of My Hero Academia and Naruto will love.

Black Clover is filled with strange or outcast characters that all fit surprisingly well together and find comfort with each other just like in the Fairy Tail guild. Both anime also have strong, pink-haired protagonists. If you like moments in Fairy Tail where the characters stand up for each other, or seek justice when they witness wrong doing, then Black Clover is for you. Asta and Natsu are different characters on the surface, but when someone they care about is in danger they do whatever it takes to protect them.

Do you still rewatch old Fairy Tail episodes? What shows would you recommend to a fan of the series? Let us know in the comments!

title: Manga Up! Global Adds Crimson Prince, The Perfect Cross-Dressing Couple, 5 More Manga
content:
Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service added seven manga titles in English over the past 10 days:

Title: Crimson Prince ( Kurenai Ōji ) Creator(s): Sōta Kuwahara Release Date: October 22 Summary: Demon prince Koujirou Sakura comes to Earth, enrolling in high school, on a mission to find the human who will threaten the future of the demon realm...and steal their souls! But with no clue as to this human's identity, Koujirou is at a loss. To make matters worse, the boys' dorm at his new school is full, and he's forced to live off campus with a girl! Oh, the humanity...!

Title: The Perfect Cross-Dressing Couple ( Josō Danshi to Dansō Joshi wa Oniai Couple ) Creator(s): Mikaduki Lamp Release Date: October 23 Summary: Shion, a gorgeous "girl" (actually male) and Yukari, a handsome "guy" (actually female). This dating couple proves that opposites attract in this romantic comedy of charming contrasts!

Title: Not Quite Love ( Koi to Yobu ni wa Sasayaka Desu ga ) Creator(s): Daisuke Hagiwara Release Date: October 24 Summary: Due to family circumstances, high school student Umi Sayama ends up having to stay with the neighboring Hiroi family. There, she's reunited with Shoya—the older boy who used to play with her as a kid. But her childhood idol, once an honor student, has degenerated into a complete homebody who never even changes out of his sweatpants! Horimiya artist Daisuke Hagiwara presents story about roommates who have a unique bond that you can't quite call love.

Title: The Evil Princess Will Kill No More ( Aku no Kōjo wa Mō Dare mo Korosanai ) Creator(s): Yakiimohokuhoku (author), Otyabomizu (artist) Release Date: October 26 Summary: Candace was so tyrannical in her quest to be loved, she earned the nickname of "Demon Princess" and was eventually executed as a result. But after her death, she wakes up to find that she's been thrown back in time. If it means avoiding such an ending, Candace will do anything. She'll give up her quest for love and even behave completely unlike herself if she has to!

Title: The Witch of Dawn ( Yoiake no Majo ) Creator(s): Sayuco Shingyōji Release Date: October 28 Summary: There once was an outrageous and irresponsible "Witch of Dawn," Gwnrose. Despite her reckless nature, with her perpetual smile, she was kinder than anyone else in the land. But now, her only disciple, Slei, must team up with the "Witch's Heart" she left behind in order to embark on a search for the other 13 witches. And so begins this dark fantasy tale!

Title: Reading Our Way to a Happy New World ( Yomutabi ni Shiawase o! ) Creator(s): Chac Choa Release Date: October 30 Summary: In this post-apocalyptic world, the perfect chronicles of human history... are manga?! This is the story of Mekuri and Kiyoshi. They're on a journey to collect and decipher all the manga they can, all while living out a happy life!

Title: My Spooky Storyteller Is an Adorable Klutz ( Watashi no Kaidan-shi wa Ponkotsu Kawaii: Kaidan Shūshū wa Date ni Fukumaremasu ka? ) Creator(s): Ougi Ishikawa (story), kodamazon (character designer), Reiri (artist) Release Date: October 31 Summary: Ao Shiroharu is a high school girl who has had a gift for the supernatural for as long as she can remember. One day, she is approached by the class loner Uta Natsume. Uta has always secretly wanted to become a ghost-storyteller, and yet she is painfully aware of how bad she is at it. When Uta learns of Ao's gift, she asks her with a beaming smile, "Will you help me collect material for my ghost stories?" Unenthused, Ao is nevertheless moved by Uta's passion and agrees to go to a midnight shrine "just this once"... only to get dragged deeper than she bargained for! The curtain rises on an inseparable high school duo's midnight adventures!

title: Anime Market Grew 15.8% to Record 4.45 Trillion Yen in 2025
content:
That included 1.91 trillion yen (about US$12.1 billion) growth in the domestic market and 2.54 trillion yen (about US$16.1 billion) growth in the overseas market.

The overall global anime market grew by 15.8% last year. The domestic market grew by 14.1% while the overseas market grew by 17.2%.

2025 was the fourth year in which the overseas market was bigger than the domestic market (after 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic, 2023 , and 2024 ).

AJA calculates the global anime market by including not just revenues from television, film, home video, and streaming releases, but also from merchandising, music releases, events, concerts, overseas licensing, and other related sources. The association distinguishes the larger overall anime market, from the smaller subset of revenues for just the companies directly involved in the production of animation.

Overseas business made up 27.9% of studio revenue, an increase of 25.5% from 2024. Revenues flowing back to production outfits increased by 8% in 2025.

Masahiro Hasegawa , the editor-in-chief for AJA's Anime Industry Report 2025, said that more production companies are taking an equity position in their works. They are holding on to the intellectual properties (IP) enabling them to participate in a share of the overseas revenue.

Anime is part of the Japanese government's five-year action plan to double the annual entertainment sales overseas from an estimated 10 trillion yen (about US$65 billion) in 2028 to 20 trillion yen (about US$130 billion) in 2033. That is 3.7 times the sales in 2024 (6.044 trillion yen or about US$39 billion).

AJA will publish the full Anime Industry Report 2026 in early December. Among other functions, AJA is also one of the main sponsors of the AnimeJapan convention (pictured above).
author: ANN

title: tri-Ace's Resonance of Fate / End of Eternity Game Gets Enhanced Remaster for PS5, Steam Available Now
content:
tri-Ace describes the story:

In the distant future, humanity faces extinction on a devastated Earth. In an effort to restore the environment, people built a colossal machine called Basel and entrusted it with the cycle of life and death. Zephyr, Vashyron, and Leanne make their living as mercenaries. As they take on new jobs, the three begin to unravel the mysteries of their world and confront their own destinies. Gunfire echoes through a closed-off world. Fate itself trembles. With every bullet, the truth is laid bare...

The enhanced remaster includes enhanced graphics and a new 2x Game Speed feature where field exploration, battles, and events run at twice the normal speed.

The new version of the game features language support in: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Traditional/Simplified Chinese, and Korean.

The game's 4K/HD remastered version launched for PlayStation 4 and PC via Steam in October 2018.

Sega released the game for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2010.

title: 'Pole Princess!!' Gets Theatrical Anime in January 2027
content:
The official website for the Pole Princess!! anime series announced a new theatrical anime titled Pole Princess!! -Croix du Nord- on Friday, revealing the returning cast and staff.

The approximately 60-minute anime will feature five new songs from the Shining Pole Song Album and an original story. It is set to receive a two-week limited theatrical screening at six theaters across Japan beginning January 29, 2027.

Voice actresses Rio Tsuchiya ( Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ), Anna Suzuki ( Mushoku no Eiyuu: Betsu ni Skill Nanka Iranakatta n da ga ), Yui Ogura ( Sayonara Lara ), Minami Hinata ( Akujiki Reijou to Kyouketsu Koushaku ), Yoshino Nanjou ( Kanan-sama wa Akumade Choroi ), Rie Kugimiya ( Dandelion ), Saori Hayami ( Oni no Hanayome ), and Rina Hidaka ( Replica datte, Koi wo Suru. ) are reprising their roles from the previous anime movie .

Hitomi Ezoe ( Ao no Hako ) is returning to direct the anime at Tatsunoko Production . Touko Machida ( Kirei ni Shitemoraemasu ka. ) is writing the script. Kotono Sakurai is designing the characters, Kenta Higashiooji ( Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu ) is composing the music. Avex Pictures is handling the music production.

Produced by Tatsunoko Production, the original net anime began releasing in Winter 2023, followed by a sequel movie that premiered in November 2023.

Synopsis The Pole Dance Japan Cup was over, but none of the four members of Galaxy Princess could stop thinking about the pole. If anything, the competition made it worse. They started taking jobs and stages outside their usual circle, and lately they'd been eyeing something new, the Lyra pole. None of them had ever used one.

The phone rang on an ordinary day. It was Yukari Mikoshiro of Eldange, the champions nobody had beaten. She was calling to ask whether Galaxy Princess would appear as guests at a stage Eldange was hosting. They said yes before she'd finished asking. Backstage and on stage, in a place most dancers never get to stand, they spent time with the group they'd looked up to for so long. It felt unreal, and they got closer to Eldange than they'd ever expected.

Back at Azumi Studio, the door opened and a girl none of them knew stepped inside. She hadn't called ahead, and she didn't say why she'd come...!?

title: Virtua Fighter Crossroads Game Reveals Character Lionel Rafale in Trailer
content:
Sega revealed a new trailer on Thursday for its Virtua Fighter Crossroads game that reveals the new character Lionel Rafale.

Sega describes the character:

"Les jeux sont faits, rien ne va plus." A mysterious young martial artist named Lionel Rafale has arrived in the city of Vilasapara. A highly skilled fighter capable of outclassing Cielo in a street fight, he is a force to be reckoned with. But what is his true reason for coming to this city?​

Sega of America describes the game:

VIRTUA FIGHTER CROSSROADS breaks from traditional competitive fighting games by delivering a narrative-driven action-adventure where story and combat seamlessly intertwine. Centered on the theme of "crossroads,” players will experience a high-stakes omnibus narrative through the eyes of four different protagonists, each driven by their own convictions and burdened by their pasts. Along the way, they will be able to explore a living, breathing city filled with activities and choice encounters. Choices made in and out of battle forge alliances, determine consequences, and shape destinies.

David Hayter ( X-Men, Watchmen, Wolves ) is the world building supervisor, and Brad Kayne ( Ghost of Tsushima ) is the lead writer. Tsuyoshi Furuta ( Like A Dragon series, Judgement ) and Shinji Yamamoto ( Persona 5 ) are the scenario writers.

Sega and its Ryu ga Gotoku Studio originally teased a new Virtua Fighter project in December 2024. In August 2025, the companies teased combat gameplay.

Ryu ga Gotoku Studio released Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. , a new version of the Virtua Fighter 5 3D fighting game, on PC via Steam in January 2025. The game includes rollback netcode, game balance improvements, and improved graphics and new models. Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown received a "ver 2.0" update that updated the game to the Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. version.

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage — an even newer version of the game with a new single player mode, crossplay, and the addition of Dural as a playable character — launched for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam in October 2025. The Steam release is a free upgrade for the base Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. game. Those who own the PlayStation 4 version of Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown can purchase Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage at a discount. Any purchased PS4 DLC packs can also be carried over to the PS5 game. Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 26.

Sega released the first installment in its long-running Virtua Fighter series in arcades in 1993. The series is notable for its three-button punch/kick/block control system and pioneering use of 3D polygon-based graphics. Sega released five main installments in the series. The developer released the latest main installment, Virtua Fighter 5 , in arcades in 2006. Sega released the latest Virtua Fighter 5 version, Virtua Fighter 5 Final Showdown , in 2010, and on the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2012. Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown (also known as Virtua Fighter esports in Japan and arcade releases), a remake of Virtua Fighter 5 in Ryu ga Gotoku's Dragon Engine, launched on PS4 in June 2021.

The game franchise received a television anime adaptation in 1995. Tubi TV is streaming the anime in English. Media Blasters released the anime on VHS volumes from 2000 to 2001, and on DVD in 2003.

The Steam release is a free upgrade for the base Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. game. Those who own the PlayStation 4 version of Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown can purchase Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage at a discount. Any purchased PS4 DLC packs can also be carried over to the PS5 game. Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. World Stage launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on March 26.

Sega released the first installment in its long-running Virtua Fighter series in arcades in 1993. The series is notable for its three-button punch/kick/block control system and pioneering use of 3D polygon-based graphics. Sega released five main installments in the series. The developer released the latest main installment, Virtua Fighter 5 , in arcades in 2006. Sega released the latest Virtua Fighter 5 version, Virtua Fighter 5 Final Showdown , in 2010, and on the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360 in 2012. Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown (also known as Virtua Fighter esports in Japan and arcade releases), a remake of Virtua Fighter 5 in Ryu ga Gotoku's Dragon Engine, launched on PS4 in June 2021.
The game franchise received a television anime adaptation in 1995. Tubi TV is streaming the anime in English. Media Blasters released the anime on VHS volumes from 2000 to 2001, and on DVD in 2003.

title: Light Novel 'Mushoku Tensei: Dasoku-hen' Concludes with Fourth Volume
content:
The official X account for Kadokawa's MF Books label announced on Friday that Rifujin na Magonote 's Mushoku Tensei: Dasoku-hen ( Mushoku Tensei: Redundant Reincarnation ) light novel will end with its fourth volume on November 25.

Rifujin penned the short story collection of Mushoku Tensei: Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu ( Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ) on Shousetsuka ni Narou website from May 2015 to September 2017. Kadokawa began publishing the novel through its MF Books label in June 2023, featuring illustrations by Sirotaka . The third volume was released in June 2025.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the light novel in English in January 2024 and released the first volume in October 2024. The third volume was released in December 2025, with the fourth and final volume scheduled for a July 2027 release.

title: Pole Princess!! Franchise Gets New CG Theatrical Anime Opening on January 29
content:
The official website for Avex Pictures and Tatsunoko Production 's original Pole Princess!! pole dancing anime project revealed on Friday a new theatrical CG anime will screen in six theaters in Japan for two weeks starting on January 29. The new anime is titled Pole Princess!! : Croix du Nord . The new anime will be 60 minutes long and will feature a pole dance show and the new character Luchika Hiyori (name romanization not confirmed). tomari designed the new character, pictured below.

The anime will star returning cast members Rio Tsuchiya , Anna Suzuki , Yui Ogura , Minami Hinata , Yoshino Nanjō , Rina Hidaka , Saori Hayami , and Rie Kugimiya .

The returning staff members include:

• Director: Hitomi Ezoe

• Screenplay: Tōko Machida

• CG Director: Yoshihiro Otobe

• Original Character Designs: tomari

• Animation Character Designs: Kotono Sakurai

• Music: Kenta Higashiohji

• Music Production: Avex Pictures

• Pole Dancing Supervisor: KAORI (STUDIO TRANSFORM)

• Animation Production: Tatsunoko Production

• Original Work: Avex Pictures, Tatsunoko Production

• Distribution: Avex Film Labels

The anime's story takes place after the "Pole Dance Japan Cup." The members of the Galaxy Princesses group receive a phone call from a member of Aile d'Ange with an offer for them to appear as guests at an event Aile d'Ange are hosting. The Galaxy Princesses accept the offer. Later, a mysterious girl suddenly visits Azumi Studio.

The franchise debuted a prologue episode 0 in December 2022, and released the first five-minute net anime episode on YouTube in January 2023. The anime has seven episodes .

The story centers on Hinano, a very normal and mild-mannered 17-year-old girl. Since she was very young her grandmother ran a planetarium that Hinano loved, but one day Hinano found out that the planetarium would be closing down. Hinano worried about whether there was anything she could do for her grandmother and for the planetarium, and she coincidentally one day catches sight of a woman dancing on a pole under a starry sky. She gathers her friends and together they set up a stage in the planetarium to perform shows, and they jump into the world of pole dancing.

Avex Pictures and Tatsunoko Pro are both credited for the original work. Hitomi Ezoe (episode director for JoJo's Bizarre Adventure franchise, Kageki Shoujo!! , Utano☆Princesama Revolutions ) directed the anime at Tatsunoko Pro . Tōko Machida ( Wake Up, Girls! , Show By Rock!! ) wrote the scripts, and tomari was in charge of the original character designs. Yoshihiro Otobe ( PriPara , KING OF PRISM by PrettyRhythm ) was the CG director. Kenta Higashiohji ( BUILD-DIVIDE -#000000- CODE BLACK , Pokémon the Movie: Secrets of the Jungle ) composed the music at Avex Pictures . KAORI of STUDIO TRANSFORM is the pole dancing supervisor.

Avex Pictures had stated in November 2023 the anime film would get an international release, but the film has not yet debuted in North America.

title: 'Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Kaketa Tsuki no Mercedes: Kyuuketsuki no Kizoku ni Tensei shita kedo Suteraresou nanode Dungeon wo Seiha suru ( Mercedes and the Waning Moon: The Dungeoneering Feats of a Discarded Vampire Aristocrat ) light novel revealed additional cast and second promotional video. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.

Cast Benkei: Kenta Miyake ( Hidarikiki no Eren ) Kuro: Ryuunosuke Watanuki ( Yomi no Tsugai ) Florian: Junichi Suwabe ( Tongari Boushi no Atelier ) Lydia Grunewald: Ai Kayano ( Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga: Suuguu Chouso Torikae Den )

Kunihisa Sugishima ( Slime Taoshite 300-nen, Shiranai Uchi ni Level Max ni Nattemashita: Sono Ni ) is directing the anime at Teddy . Jun Kumagai ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai ) is handling the series composition. Nami Shouyama ( Buddy Daddies animation director) is designing the characters, while R・O・N ( Kuroko no Basket ) and Shuuhei Mutsuki ( Lycoris Recoil ) and composing the music.

Firehead originally began writing the adventure fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2018. TO Books began printing the series featuring illustrations by KeG ( Gaikotsu Kishi-sama, Tadaima Isekai e Odekakechuu ) in May 2021 and released the fourth volume in August 2025. The fifth volume went on sale on July 15.

A manga adaptation by Pochi Edoya ( Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku manga) began on the Corona EX website in August 2021. TO Books published the sixth volume on July 15.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English for digital release in November 2024 and released the fourth novel volume on February 13. The fifth manga volume was published on August 5.

title: Destiny Unchain Online TV Anime to Star Ikumi Hasegawa
content:
The official website for the television anime of author resn and artist Yachimoto 's Destiny Unchain Online: How I Became the Crimson Devil ( Destiny Unchain Online: Kyūketsuki Shōjo to Natte, Yagate "Aka no Maō" to Yobareru Yō ni Narimashita ) novels revealed the show's teaser promotional video, visual, 2027 debut, main staff, and main cast member on Friday.

The anime will star Ikumi Hasegawa as Crim / Kou Mitsuki.

Kōichi Hatsumi ( Deadman Wonderland , Blue Exorcist: Kyoto Saga ) is directing the anime at studio Voil . Seiko Takagi ( Samurai Champloo , Ergo Proxy ) is overseeing the series scripts, and Masashi Kudo ( Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War , Tower of God ) is designing the characters. Composers include: Yūki Hayashi ( My Hero Academia , Haikyu!! ), Yūki Furuhashi ( My Hero Academia: Vigilantes , Kaiju Girl Caramelise ), and Hayato.

Kou Mitsuki is a gamer with god-tier skills, known online as Crim the Headhunter. Right when he starts testing his father's latest game, Destiny Unchain Online, and the new device developed for it, the bug-ridden system transforms him in into a vampire girl! Everything changes for Kou as he meets new friends and they take on the game... The ultimate gamer adventure awaits!

resn began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in May 2020. resn later deleted his profile and subsequently removed the story from the site, but later resumed the story's serialization on Kadokawa 's Kakuyomu website in June 2021. Kodansha released the first print volume of the story in November 2022, some months after Yachimoto launched the manga adaptation. Yachimoto also drew the art for the novels. The third volume shipped on May 29.

Yachimoto launched the manga in Kodansha 's Magazine Pocket app in July 2022, and also launched it in Kodansha 's Shōnen Magazine R digital magazine beginning in August 2022. After Shōnen Magazine R ceased publication, the manga has only been running on Magazine Pocket . Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on August 7.
